fault.label_source: real induced fault on a real vehicle (edgeimpulse/obd-automotive-data, BMW N53), not lab-bench or synthetic data
fault.note: Binary fault-vs-normal classifier using only standard OBD-II PIDs (RPM, accelerator pedal position, MAF). Confidence is the model's own estimated probability, not a diagnostic certainty.
fault.scope_limitation: Single vehicle, single healthy/fault session pair. No cross-vehicle or cross-session generalization has been tested.

driver_behaviour.method: KMeans (unsupervised profiling, not a predictive classifier)
